cells.value: Schema: core - prepared 05 Nov 2026 from 'DB-Tables-2.xlsx' (KINDA column value guide) with review fixes applied

Every table, column and allowed value of Rajath H's 6 tables: the 5 allocated (discovery_dismissals, acknowledgements, conversations, messages, message_read_cursors) + conversation_participants, which he added for group chat. Other members' tables are not included.
New or modified compared with the original workbook. The 'Change' column says exactly what changed. Removed items are listed in 'What Changed'.
Tables -> Data Dictionary (every column) -> Value Lists (table > column > values) -> Relationships.
Every user reference is <column> UUID REFERENCES core.users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT. core.users belongs to the identity team.
ON DELETE RESTRICT everywhere. Data types, required and defaults were not in the original sheet - they are proposed (confirm with the SQL). Status lists are named CHECKs.
PK = primary key. FK = link to another table. UNIQUE = no duplicates. CHECK = rule the database enforces.
What changed from the original workbook
Review fixes applied in this dictionary.
5 allocated (discovery_dismissals, acknowledgements, conversations, messages, message_read_cursors) + conversation_participants (his addition).

10 columns: his 9 + removed_by_user_id. Not in the allocation - included because he designed it for group chat. Rules: one active membership per user, one active owner per group, left_at required when not active, banned cannot be re-added, direct chat = exactly 2 members.
Must be an active row in conversation_participants (replaces 'member of the conversation' check).
11 -> 49 codes (his update). Row 'Other specific reason' has no code; political_disagreement / belief_difference flagged as sensitive; 4 near-duplicates flagged; safety reasons also open a report.
8 -> 30 codes (his update). Only 6 match core.interests categories (Thanushree).
